subject: Literature
title: Toni Morrison and the Black Experience in America
description: One-minute skill: Toni Morrison and the Black Experience in America.

hook.text: Toni Morrison won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1993, becoming the first African American woman to receive the honor.

buildup.text: Her novel Beloved, based on a true story, explores a mother who kills her child rather than let her be returned to slavery.

discovery.text: Morrison said she wrote the books she wanted to read, because no one else was writing them for Black readers.

twist.text: Beloved was initially rejected by many critics and did not win the National Book Award, sparking outrage among Black writers.

climax.text: Morrison gave American literature a voice it had suppressed for centuries and proved that Black stories are universal stories.

punchline.text: She wrote the books nobody else would, and they changed everything.

quiz.question: Why did Morrison say she wrote her novels?
options: To educate white readers about Black history
She wrote the books she wanted to read, because no one else was writing them
To win literary prizes and critical recognition
